summary: Frontend-only targeted validation completed for uploadFile fallback change. Web preview boots on public URL, upload fallback code path is syntactically valid, and dedupe logic prevents duplicate upload-URL mutation attempts.

integration_issues.flow: Voice note send/upload URL generation in authenticated chat
integration_issues.issue: Could not execute end-to-end upload/send from chat in this run because no authenticated credentials/session were available; validation is code-path + smoke only.

action_items: Run authenticated device/web chat test for voice note send to verify runtime fallback from files.generateUploadUrl to ads.generateUploadUrl under Convex function-missing condition.
Add one integration test around uploadFile to simulate primary mutation failure and assert exactly one fallback attempt + successful storageId extraction.
Optional hardening: default upload mutation argument can be made null-safe ((api as any).files?.generateUploadUrl) so fallback still executes if files module is absent in generated API shape.
critical_code_review_comments: uploadFile.ts fallback implementation is logically correct for current incident: it first tries primary mutation, then tries ads.generateUploadUrl, preserving prior error behavior when all attempts fail.

Duplicate mutation prevention is present: attempts are deduplicated by mutation reference, so callers already passing api.ads.generateUploadUrl (e.g., ads/create flow) do not trigger duplicate requests.
No syntax/code-path regression detected in modified files during web boot smoke and targeted lint for src/lib/uploadFile.ts.
Repository has pre-existing lint/typecheck failures outside this change scope; they currently limit full-project regression guarantees.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This run covered smoke + static path checks only. Use authenticated chat flow to force files.generateUploadUrl failure and verify fallback path in live upload/send.
rca_of_issue: Likely RCA from provided screenshot: Convex deployment/function namespace mismatch causes files:generateUploadUrl to fail at runtime. New fallback mitigates by trying ads.generateUploadUrl. Separate user confusion about old push project/build info can occur when running an older installed native binary (embedded native config/projectId) while loading newer JS bundle/preview changes; JS-visible UI updates may appear without native push config changing until a new native build is installed. MOCKED APIs: NONE.
